request.style: English, Sunday gospel, rich alto female lead with gospel choir, Hammond organ, piano, bass, drums, hand claps, from lament to shout, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In Bethany a man lay sick, the one the Lord held dear
Yes, Lord
The sisters sent a message, Lord, the one you love is ill
Yes, Lord
But four days in the tomb had passed before the Lord came near
Yes, Lord
And Martha ran to meet him, while Mary stayed home still
Yes, Lord

[Verse]
Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died
Yes, Lord
Your brother will rise again, the Teacher answered her
Yes, Lord
And when he saw them weeping, he was troubled deep inside
Yes, Lord
Where have you laid him, he asked, and they said, come and see
Yes, Lord

[Chorus]
I am the resurrection and the life
Whoever believes in me will live, even though he dies
And everyone who lives and believes in me will never die
Do you believe this

[Verse]
Jesus wept, and they said, see how he loved him
Lazarus, come out
Take away the stone, he said, though four days had gone by
Lazarus, come out
He lifted up his eyes and thanked the Father in the sky
Lazarus, come out
Then he called out in a loud voice
Lazarus, come out

[Bridge]
Unbind him and let him go
Unbind him and let him go

[Chorus]
I am the resurrection and the life
Whoever believes in me will live, even though he dies
And everyone who lives and believes in me will never die
Do you believe this

[Outro]
Yes, Lord, I believe
Lazarus, come out
